description: This file contains utility functions for importing and managing datasets in Apache Superset, including data type mapping, data URI validation, dataset import logic, and data loading from URIs.

methods.name: get_sqla_type
methods.description: Maps a native type string to a SQLAlchemy type object, handling VARCHAR with size.

methods.name: get_dtype
methods.description: Generates a dictionary mapping column names to SQLAlchemy types based on DataFrame and dataset schema.

methods.name: validate_data_uri
methods.description: Checks if a data URI matches allowed URL patterns configured in the application.

methods.name: import_dataset
methods.description: Imports or updates a dataset in the database, optionally overwriting existing data and loading data from a URI.

methods.name: load_data
methods.description: Downloads data from a URI, optionally decompresses, reads into a DataFrame, and loads into the database.
